checks: Self-service starts without fictional catalog, barber, customers, sales or stock
Account mail with no provider is not marked delivered; unverified account sees safe own status only
First-day guide reflects real persisted schedule, services, team and first cash opening
Wizard preserves intentional zero commissions and zero price, creating only selected resources
Invalid schedules, zones, commissions, prices and service durations have no partial onboarding effects
Wizard can start with no barber and no selected catalog
Foreign branch and non-owner cannot change preparation or read company mail
Provider acceptance stores correlation ID but never claims delivery
Unsigned, altered and expired webhook signatures fail without adding events
Duplicate concurrent deliveries count once and stale sent/delayed events cannot downgrade delivery
Early callback is retained and reconciled after API acceptance saves its message ID
Provider failure remains retryable and uses the same immutable request
Hard bounce and complaint override delivery; future mail to a suppressed recipient is never sent
Signed suppression and unrelated events expose no payload or cross-business account data
Domain and DNS verification are separate from keys and from proof of real delivery
Manual catalog services have no invented stock and registration has no invented address
proveedor: Doble controlado; no acredita entrega real ni DNS
